prompt: maxmemory is configured and the dataset reaches the limit. Which outcomes are possible, depending on the eviction policy?
explanation: The policy decides what happens at the ceiling: noeviction rejects write commands with an out-of-memory error, allkeys-lru evicts the least recently used keys to make room, and volatile-ttl evicts keys with a TTL that are closest to expiry. Redis never simply ignores the limit and keeps growing.

options.text: Under noeviction, write commands fail with an out-of-memory error
Under allkeys-lru, least recently used keys are evicted to make room
Redis accepts the write and keeps growing past maxmemory regardless of policy
Under volatile-ttl, keys carrying a TTL and closest to expiry are evicted first
